The number of additive subgroups of \((\mathbb Z/2^m\mathbb Z)^3\) is

\[
\boxed{\frac{14(3m-1)4^m+9m+23}{9}}.
\]

Let \(p=2\). A subgroup \(H\le (\mathbb Z/p^m\mathbb Z)^3\) has invariant factor type

\[
H\cong \mathbb Z/p^a\mathbb Z\oplus \mathbb Z/p^b\mathbb Z\oplus \mathbb Z/p^c\mathbb Z,
\qquad m\ge a\ge b\ge c\ge 0.
\]

Instead of summing directly over \((a,b,c)\), use the conjugate profile

\[
r_i=\#\{a,b,c\ge i\},\qquad i=1,\dots,m,
\]

so

\[
3\ge r_1\ge r_2\ge \cdots \ge r_m\ge r_{m+1}=0.
\]

For a fixed profile \((r_i)\), the number of subgroups with that profile is

\[
\prod_{i=1}^m
2^{r_{i+1}(3-r_i)}
\binom{3-r_{i+1}}{r_i-r_{i+1}}_2,
\]

where \(\binom nk_2\) is the Gaussian binomial coefficient over \(\mathbb F_2\). This comes from choosing, layer by layer in the \(2\)-adic filtration, which new cyclic generators begin at level \(i\), while the \(r_{i+1}\) existing generators may be lifted in \(2^{3-r_i}\) ways each.

Thus the total count is the sum over all decreasing profiles. Encode the layer transition \(r_i=x\), \(r_{i+1}=y\) by the matrix

\[
T_{x,y}
=
2^{y(3-x)}
\binom{3-y}{x-y}_2
\qquad (0\le y\le x\le 3).
\]

For \(p=2\),

\[
T=
\begin{pmatrix}
1&0&0&0\\
7&4&0&0\\
7&6&4&0\\
1&1&1&1
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

The desired number is

\[
S_m=\sum_{x=0}^3 (T^m)_{x,0}.
\]

Let

\[
a_m=(T^m)_{0,0},\quad b_m=(T^m)_{1,0},\quad c_m=(T^m)_{2,0},\quad d_m=(T^m)_{3,0}.
\]

Then

\[
a_m=1,
\]

\[
b_{m+1}=7+4b_m
\implies
b_m=\frac{7(4^m-1)}{3},
\]

\[
c_{m+1}=7+6b_m+4c_m
\implies
c_m=\left(\frac{7m}{2}-\frac73\right)4^m+\frac73,
\]

and

\[
d_{m+1}=1+b_m+c_m+d_m.
\]

Since

\[
1+b_k+c_k=1+\frac{7k}{2}4^k,
\]

we get

\[
d_m
=
m+\frac72\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}k4^k
=
m+\frac{7}{18}\left(4+(3m-4)4^m\right).
\]

Therefore

\[
S_m=a_m+b_m+c_m+d_m
=
\frac{14(3m-1)4^m+9m+23}{9}.
\]

So the required number is

\[
\boxed{\frac{14(3m-1)4^m+9m+23}{9}}.
\]
